texts.preamble: Bonda Manikanta vs State Of Ap on 30 January, 2020 Author: Cheekati Manavendranath Roy Bench: Cheekati Manavendranath Roy The Hon'Ble Sri Justice Cheekati Manavendranath Roy Criminal Petition No.306 Of 2020 Order:
texts.facts: - This petition is filed under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 to enlarge the petitioners on bail. 2. The petitioners are A-1 to A-4 in Crime No.20 of 2020 of Arundalpet Police Station of Guntur District. 3. The alleged offences against them are under Sections 307, 353, 420, 273, 188 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 (for short "I.P.C.") and Section 8 (c) r/w 20 (b) of Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985 and Sections 58, 59, 63 of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 (for short "FSS Act, 2006). 4. The case of the prosecution is that on17.01.2020, on receipt of reliable information regarding illegal possession of Ganja, Gutka, Khaini and other banned products by some persons, the inspector of police, Arundal police station along with his staff members visited the scene of offence and at that time, he found the petitioners and others with some bags. On seeing the police, they tried to run away from the scene of offence. Police apprehended them. At that time, A-1 squeezed the neck of the constable P.C.No.4722 by name Ramu and tried to run away from the scene of offence. The other petitioners also obstructed the police persons from discharging their duty. After their arrest, the police found three white colour plastic covers and black colour polythene covers in their possession. When they checked the same, they found 200 grams of Ganja and other banned products like Gutka, Khaini etc. Police seized the contraband and arrested them. Therefore, the petitioners have committed the aforesaid offences. Police seized the said contraband from the possession of the petitioners. In the said process, petitioners also tried to abscond from the scene of offence by resisting the police from discharging their duties.
texts.arguments: 6. Learned counsel for the petitioners would submit that no offence under Section 307 I.P.C is made out from the facts of the case and no offence under Section 353 I.P.C also is made out from the facts of the case regarding obstructing the employees from discharge their duties. He would contend that the above product would not come within the purview of FSS Act, 2006. The Ganja that was found is also a small quantity of 200 grams. Therefore, he prayed for grant of bail to the petitioners. Bonda Manikanta vs State Of Ap on 30 January, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/147803994/ 1 7. He would submit that when the police reached the scene of offence after receiving information regarding the commission of the aforesaid offences, the petitioners have tried to abscond from the scene of offence by obstructing the police from discharging their duties. A-1 also tried to squeeze the neck of the one of the constables and kill him in the said process. He would further submit that since the petitioners were found to be in possession of banned products like Gutka, Khaini and Ganja etc., and as investigation is still pending and having regard to the nature of the offence in which the petitioners are involved, he prayed for dismissal of the petition.
